findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_queue.py:94-107 validates read_platform_config(root), which already merges operator values over project values at template/scripts/_platform_common.py:210-216. With project coordinator_app=123 and an enabled operator config containing coordinator_app="valid-app", trusted_apps returns {'valid-app'} without error (reproduced using in-memory file mocks). A non-table project publication value is likewise replaceable before validation. The active delta requires every configured trust source to be validated and invalid platform values to fail explicitly; design D3 also requires sources to be read under their own contracts.
findings.summary: An operator override can hide invalid project trust configuration, violating the fail-closed contract.
